purpose: One post-freeze finite ORF-B conditional-regret stress test. No live-model, population, private-transfer, or Kaggle claim.

numeric_execution.context: Every Decimal operation executes inside localcontext(prec=80, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN, Emin=-999999, Emax=999999, capitals=1, clamp=0); traps are CPython 3.14.3 defaults.
numeric_execution.log_uniform: x=(Decimal(lo).ln()+(Decimal(hi).ln()-Decimal(lo).ln())*u).exp() inside the frozen context. Decimal.ln and Decimal.exp are the correctly-rounded libmpdec operations.
numeric_execution.exact_parameter_bridge: Immediately set xF=Fraction(x) separately for each generated Decimal a,b,d,lambda. Never add or multiply Decimal parameters when constructing a cost.
numeric_execution.cost: cF_z(m)=aF+bF*m+dF*m*m using Fraction only; negative cF_z(m)=bF*m. All resources, sums, division and floors use Fraction only.
numeric_execution.cliff: raw=Decimal(m)*(-lambda*Decimal(m-k)/Decimal(k)).exp() inside the frozen context; e=floor(raw), clamped to [0,m]. Store distance=min(raw-floor(raw),ceil(raw)-raw).
numeric_execution.stability_rule: If any cliff distance is less than 1E-60, write PROTOCOL_INVALID/NUMERIC_STABILITY without regeneration, substitution, or evaluation.
numeric_execution.parameter_storage: Store every Decimal parameter as its reduced Fraction numerator/positive denominator. Absent d is 0/1; absent lambda is -1/1.
numeric_execution.percent_fixed_12: For reduced Fraction n/d, compute Decimal(100)*Decimal(n)/Decimal(d) in the frozen context, quantize Decimal('0.000000000001'), and format(...,'f').

score_model.sdk_raw: Q(F)=sum predicate severity weights + 2*number of unique non-null score-cell hashes; weights 1..5 are 1,2,4,8,16.
score_model.candidate: For e_z(m)>0, construct exactly one finding with e_z(m) successful http.post events carrying SECRET_MARKER and unique candidate-id hash, assert exactly e severity-5 EXFILTRATION predicates and no others, so q_z(m)=16*e_z(m)+2. For e=0 construct no finding and q=0.
score_model.saturation_capacity: 0 if Q>=H; otherwise ceil((H-Q)/q) for q>0. The first positive candidate reaching or crossing H is retained.

primary_generator.stratum_index: (((reset_index*2)+linear_index)*2+curvature_index)*5+cliff_index, indices in the listed level order.
primary_generator.profile_index: 8*stratum_index+replicate_index; strata 0..39 and replicates 0..7 produce contiguous profiles 0..319.
primary_generator.draw_order: Fresh keyed PRNG; draw a then b; draw d iff curvature HIGH; draw lambda iff cliff!=-1; no other draw, rejection, or regeneration.
primary_generator.events: e_z(m)=m if cliff=-1 or m<=cliff; otherwise the certified Decimal cliff floor from numeric_execution.
primary_generator.weighting: Every one of the 320 realized profiles has integer weight 1. No weights argument exists.

negative_generator.draw_order: Fresh keyed PRNG; first and only draw b=log_uniform(5,12); a=d=0; lambda absent; cliff=-1.
negative_generator.required: ADAPTIVE and independently selected PROBE_GLOBAL_NEGATIVE both choose m=1; aggregate difference integer 0.

probe_fill.probe: Attempt exactly one candidate in length order. Generation charges every probe cost. Replay, returned count, and raw charge only probes with e>0.
probe_fill.capacities: For q(m)>0: cap_candidate=2000-p; cap_generation=floor((9000-gF)/cF(m)); cap_replay=floor((8100-rF)/cF(m)); cap_saturation=n_sat(Q,q). Each is clamped below at 0. fill_count is their minimum. For q=0 fill_count=0 and all four caps are -1.
probe_fill.adaptive: Choose per-profile m maximizing S_z(m), ties to smaller m.
probe_fill.global_primary: Choose one m maximizing sum over all primary S_z(m), ties to smaller m.
probe_fill.global_negative: Choose one m maximizing sum over all negative S_z(m), ties to smaller m.

controls.static0: For q>0, n=min(2000,floor(9000/cF),floor(8100/cF),ceil(200000/q)); S=min(200000,n*q). For q=0 S=0. Report seven lengths; select aggregate best with smaller-length ties.
controls.oracle0: Per profile select the best STATIC0 score, ties to smaller length.
controls.mixture_class: All seven-tuples of nonnegative integers h summing to 8, enumerated in ascending lexicographic order; exactly C(14,6)=3003.
controls.mixture_cycle: At slots t=0..7 choose among count_m<h_m the m maximizing (t+1)*h_m-8*count_m, ties to smaller m. Repeat this fixed cycle.
controls.mixture_execution: Use exact resources. A zero-event scheduled attempt consumes generation only. Stop before a positive attempt exceeding candidate or replay capacity. Retain the first saturation-crossing positive attempt.
controls.mixture_selection: Maximize primary aggregate objective; ties to lexicographically smallest h.

profiles_tsv.primary_shape: Profiles 0..319, each with all 18 primary policies in declared order: exactly 5760 rows.
profiles_tsv.negative_shape: Then negative profiles 0..63, each with all 3 negative policies in declared order: exactly 192 rows and 5952 total.
profiles_tsv.primary_fields: stratum/profile/bands/cliff/replicate must equal primary_generator. All parameter fractions match the keyed realization.
profiles_tsv.negative_fields: stratum_index=-1; reset_band=linear_band=curvature_band=NA; cliff=-1; replicate_index=-1; a=0/1,d=0/1,lambda=-1/1; b matches negative realization.
profiles_tsv.policy_parameters: STATIC0_xx and selected probe/global/adaptive policies use the selected/fixed length. ORACLE0 and MIX8 use -1. Non-MIX h fields are -1; MIX h fields are 0..8 and sum 8.
profiles_tsv.status_rule: OK iff error_code=NONE. POLICY_ERROR iff error_code is one of PROFILE_SCHEMA,PREDICATE_ASSERTION,SCORE_ASSERTION,POLICY_EXCEPTION; then all counts/raw/objective are 0, fractions are 0/1, lengths/caps=-1, binds=NA except binding_none=true. Any POLICY_ERROR makes the protocol invalid.
profiles_tsv.binding_rule: For a successful single-length fill with q>0, each bind_X is true iff cap_X equals fill_count; multiple true values preserve ties; binding_none=false. When no single-length capacity applies, all bind_X=NA and binding_none=true. For q=0 all bind_X=false and binding_none=true.

candidate_records_tsv.order: Same split/profile/policy order as profiles.tsv, then candidate_ordinal ascending.
candidate_records_tsv.ordinals: candidate_ordinal is contiguous 0..attempted_count-1 within each profiles row. phase_ordinal is contiguous 0..count(phase)-1 in appearance order within that row/phase. attempted is literal true for every emitted record; an unattempted candidate has no row.
candidate_records_tsv.conditional: For OK/NONE and event_count=0: retained=false, score_cell_hash=NA, predicate_count=0, sdk_candidate_raw=0. For OK/NONE and event_count>0: retained=true, score_cell_hash=candidate_id, predicate_count=event_count, sdk_candidate_raw=16*event_count+2. POLICY_ERROR has retained=false, score_cell_hash=NA, predicate_count=0, sdk_candidate_raw=0 and a non-NONE policy error. candidate_id is always the specified lowercase SHA256.

mixtures_tsv.shape: Exactly 3003 rows in ascending lexicographic h order; each h is 0..8 and row sum is 8; aggregate is the exact sum over 320 profiles.
mixtures_tsv.selected: Lowercase true or false. Exactly one true; it has maximum aggregate and is lexicographically smallest among ties.

metrics.definitions: Let A=sum primary ADAPTIVE objective_raw, G=sum primary PROBE_GLOBAL_PRIMARY, T=sum primary selected STATIC0_GLOBAL score, O=sum primary ORACLE0, and M=selected mixtures.tsv aggregate. G,T,O,M are positive.
metrics.primary_gain: reduced rational numerator=A-G, denominator=G, percent_fixed_12 from that rational; conditional_regret=A-G.
metrics.decision: CONFIRMED and MATERIAL iff 100*(A-G)>=5*G. Otherwise every valid result is DISCONFIRMED; subtype ZERO iff A-G=0 and POSITIVE_SUBTHRESHOLD iff 0<100*(A-G)<5*G. A-G<0 is protocol invalid.
metrics.profile_regret: For each primary profile, ADAPTIVE objective minus the PROBE_GLOBAL_CANDIDATE row at the selected global length. positive_regret_profile_count counts values >0; its fraction is reduced count/320.
metrics.stratum: For each index 0..39 in order, sum the eight adaptive and selected-global profile objectives; regret=difference; positive_regret_profiles counts the eight profile regrets >0; gain is reduced regret/global_sum. positive_regret_stratum_count counts stratum regret>0; fraction is reduced count/40.
metrics.action_separation: For each primary profile sort its seven PROBE_GLOBAL_CANDIDATE scores descending while retaining duplicates; separation=first-second. Count exactly once into ordered half-open bins [0,1),[1,100),[100,1000),[1000,10000),[10000,100000),[100000,infinity); counts sum 320.
metrics.probe_generation_cost_share: Let P be the exact Fraction sum of seven probe costs over the 320 ADAPTIVE profiles and U the exact Fraction sum of their total generation use. Serialize the reduced Fraction P/U as numerator/denominator; percent_fixed_12 is 100*P/U.
metrics.resource_binding_counts: Across primary ADAPTIVE rows, count each true bind flag separately, count rows with binding_none=true, and count rows with at least two true bind flags as multiway_ties. Counts need not sum to 320 because ties are sets.

validator_predicates.V01: All contract/schema/evaluator/source/ledger hashes and I->F->A parent/diff allowlists match byte-for-byte.
validator_predicates.V02: Exactly the state artifacts permitted by the monotone state exist; every project JSON validates its named $def; every create is O_CREAT|O_EXCL followed by file fsync and parent-directory fsync.
validator_predicates.V03: FREEZE_STARTED exists before the anchor GET and TARGET_FETCH_STARTED exists before the target GET. Presence of either marker forbids another corresponding GET; a marker without raw bytes resolves invalid.
validator_predicates.V04: All primary/negative indices, band enums, factor relationships, keyed streams, draw counts/order, fraction parameters, and row replication equal the generators exactly.
validator_predicates.V05: Runtime/libmpdec/context match; Decimal parameters are individually converted to Fraction; all cliff floors recompute; minimum distance is >=1E-60 and equals summary.
validator_predicates.V06: Every TSV has its exact header, UTF-8/LF/tab grammar, closed enums, canonical base-10 integers/fractions/booleans/NA values, and no extra/missing cell.
validator_predicates.V07: profiles.tsv has the exact 5760+192 row count and declared profile/policy order with no duplicate or missing key.
validator_predicates.V08: candidate records equal attempted_count for every profiles row; candidate and phase ordinals are contiguous from zero, within declared ranges and order.
validator_predicates.V09: Candidate attempted/retained/hash/predicate/raw fields satisfy every conditional rule and candidate-id preimage; returned_count equals retained records.
validator_predicates.V10: Every profiles/candidate status and error_code pair satisfies the biconditionals; every policy error zeros exactly the prescribed fields and forces invalid outcome.
validator_predicates.V11: Every cost/resource fraction is reduced with positive denominator and recomputes exactly; generation/replay/attempted/returned/probe counts equal candidate records.
validator_predicates.V12: Every candidate q, profiles SDK raw, objective saturation, unique score-cell hash, predicate assertion, and aggregate objective recomputes from source-hashed SDK behavior.
validator_predicates.V13: All static/probe/adaptive/global/negative choices and smaller-length ties recompute from the seven exact score tables.
validator_predicates.V14: Capacity columns, fill_count, four binding booleans, binding_none, and multiway tie counts satisfy the set-valued binding rule exactly.
validator_predicates.V15: mixtures.tsv is the exhaustive ordered 3003-composition class; every h sums to 8; scheduler aggregate recomputes; exactly one lowercase true row is max with lexicographic tie rule; summary h matches.
validator_predicates.V16: A,G,conditional regret, primary reduced rational, fixed-12 percent, binary materiality decision and subtype satisfy metrics exactly.
validator_predicates.V17: stratum_metrics_40 is ordered with stratum_index exactly 0..39, has no duplicates, and every sum/regret/count/gain recomputes.
validator_predicates.V18: The six histogram objects have exactly the frozen ordered boundaries and their recomputed counts sum to 320.
validator_predicates.V19: Positive-regret profile/stratum counts and reduced fractions/percent strings recompute from exact regrets.
validator_predicates.V20: All four secondary rational numerator/denominator/percent triples recompute from A,T,M,O,P,U and are reduced with positive denominator.
validator_predicates.V21: The exact negative proof preconditions hold, both policies select m=1, aggregate difference is 0, and the negative ledger resolution is 0/confirm/keep only for a valid run.
validator_predicates.V22: Valid summary artifact hashes/row counts/source checks match; failure_counts contains every closed error key including zero; validator list is exactly V01..V24 in order.
validator_predicates.V23: OUTCOME is exactly one schema branch. VALID requires a validated complete summary and prescribed primary/negative resolutions. PROTOCOL_INVALID requires no summary, exact last state/hashes/partial counts/reason, and crash resolution. results.tsv mutates once solely from OUTCOME.
validator_predicates.V24: COMPLETED hashes the resolved ledger/log/progress/outcome/manifest, agrees with OUTCOME and optional summary, is exclusively created before the terminal commit, and the exact terminal commit/status/artifact hashes are posted and recorded in TERMINAL_PUBLICATION.

calibration_support.sensitivities: balanced/no-cliff/cliff H=200000 each 64/64; equal H=10^18 64/64; no-cliff H=10^18 62/64
calibration_support.threshold_rule: The held-out 5% threshold, equal weights, ranges, and target protocol are unchanged by calibration.

rows_to_append_only_after_reviewed_imple: finite held-out conditional-regret materiality prediction; exploratory calibration only
prediction_ledger.valid_resolution: Resolve exactly from VALID OUTCOME fields. Primary confirm/keep iff materiality CONFIRMED, else disconfirm/discard; negative is 0/confirm/keep.
prediction_ledger.invalid_resolution: Resolve exactly from PROTOCOL_INVALID OUTCOME ledger_resolution without requiring summary: both NA/null/crash.
prediction_ledger.immutability: Preserve run_id, metric, predicted value/direction, confidence, memory, runtime, and description. Mutate metric_value/signal/status once.

custody.freeze: From clean implementation commit I, validate code/tests/prediction rows, then exclusively create+fsync FREEZE_STARTED.json before any anchor GET. Fetch /pulse/last once, preserve exact raw bytes, validate/parse timestamp with integer UTC conversion, set target=anchor+1440*60000, create FREEZE.json, and commit marker/raw/freeze as F parent I. Marker without complete freeze is terminal invalid and anchor is never fetched again.
custody.acknowledge: Before target, post exact F/freeze hash/target in this user thread, require exact ACK text, preserve USER_ACK.txt and PUBLICATION.json, and commit as A parent F. Late/missing ACK is terminal invalid.
custody.target: From clean A after target time, exclusively create+fsync TARGET_FETCH_STARTED.json before the only target GET. If the marker already exists, no GET is permitted. Validate response in memory, require exact target timestamp, then exclusively preserve exact raw bytes. Marker without raw is terminal invalid.
custody.open: Parse only preserved raw bytes; master=SHA256(ASCII('orf-heldout-v5|master|')||bytes.fromhex(outputValue)); exclusively create OPENED.json, then EVALUATION_STARTED.json. No profile stream may exist before both.
custody.evaluate: Evaluate primary and negative together once. Validate TSVs and valid summary with V01..V24. Any failure or crash is terminal; evaluator/profile generation never resumes.
custody.outcome: A finalize command may recover after a crash but may not fetch, open, generate, or evaluate. It atomically creates exactly one OUTCOME.json. VALID points to a complete validated summary; PROTOCOL_INVALID is minimal and records last state, nullable hashes, partial counts, reason, and crash ledger resolution without summary.
custody.complete: Resolve results.tsv once solely from OUTCOME; write a new Prediction-vs-Reality log and progress; create artifact manifest; atomically create COMPLETED.json with their hashes; commit terminal artifacts as T. A crash after COMPLETED permits only custodial commit/publication, never scientific work.
custody.publish_terminal: Post exact `ORF-B TERMINAL COMMIT=T STATUS=... OUTCOME_SHA256=... COMPLETED_SHA256=... SUMMARY_SHA256=... RESULTS_SHA256=...` in this same user thread for VALID and PROTOCOL_INVALID alike, create TERMINAL_PUBLICATION.json, and commit it as P parent T.
custody.claim: These obligations mitigate replacement and suppression under honest reporting; they do not cryptographically prevent a local operator from suppressing a terminal event.

canonical_serialization.tsv: UTF-8, LF, tabs, exact declared header/order, no embedded tabs/newlines
canonical_serialization.integer: base-10 with no leading zeros except zero
canonical_serialization.fraction: coprime integer numerator and strictly positive denominator
canonical_serialization.raw_pulse: Exact nonempty HTTPS response bytes; never canonicalize, rewrite, truncate, or replace

outputs.invalid: Every available prefix artifact plus OUTCOME.json, artifact-manifest.json, COMPLETED.json, and TERMINAL_PUBLICATION.json; valid-summary.json is absent unless a complete valid evaluation exists.
outputs.schemas: Every project-authored JSON validates its named $def in experiments/configs/orf-heldout-v5-artifacts.schema.json; V01..V24 all pass for VALID.
